subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main reproduction of the global-scope secondary-agent heartbeat route before queueing a fix PR?
rationale: Source inspection supports the reporter's latest hypothesis, but global session-store routing is compatibility-sensitive and the issue is already marked for maintainer review and live reproduction.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Reproduce the WSL2/Docker global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage against the confirmed path.

options.title: Queue source-level repair now
options.body: Accept the source evidence and let a repair PR attempt a focused fix plus tests before live proof.

options.title: Fold into broader session routing review
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer the fix until adjacent heartbeat/global-session routing issues are handled together.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Reproduce the WSL2/Docker global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage against the confirmed path.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and the prior related cron fix review point to vincentkoc as the strongest routing/history contact for this proof decision.
